114    protected function detectMultiBookPattern(string $title): ?array
115    {

123        foreach ($patterns as $pattern) {
124            if (!preg_match($pattern, $title, $matches)) {
125                continue;
126            }
127
128            $seriesName = trim($matches[1]);
129            $start = (int) $matches[2];
130            $end = (int) $matches[3];
131
132            if ($end <= $start || ($end - $start) > 200) {
133                continue;
134            }
135
136            return [
137                'series_name' => $seriesName,
138                'start_number' => $start,
139                'end_number' => $end,
140                'numbers' => range($start, $end),
141            ];
142        }
143
144        return null;
145    }
146
147    protected function analyzeMultiBookFiles(array $audiobook, array $multiBookInfo): array
148    {
149        $files = $audiobook['files'] ?? [];
150        $numbers = $multiBookInfo['numbers'] ?? [];
151        $seriesName = $multiBookInfo['series_name'] ?? '';
152        $splitGroups = [];
153
154        foreach ($files as $filePath) {
155            $filename = basename($filePath);
156            $assigned = false;
157
158            foreach ($numbers as $number) {
159                $numberPattern = sprintf('/\b0*%d\b/', $number);
160
161                if (preg_match($numberPattern, $filename)) {
162                    $title = $this->extractBookTitleFromFilename($filename, $seriesName, $number);
163                    $splitGroups[$number][] = [
164                        'file' => $filePath,
165                        'title' => $title,
166                    ];
167                    $assigned = true;
168                    break;
169                }
170            }
171
172            if (!$assigned) {
173                $splitGroups['unmatched'][] = [
174                    'file' => $filePath,
175                    'title' => $this->extractBookTitleFromFilename($filename, $seriesName, 0),
176                ];
177            }
178        }
179
180        return $splitGroups;
181    }
182
183    protected function cleanSeriesName(string $seriesName, array $authors): string
184    {
185        $cleaned = trim($seriesName);
186
187        foreach ($authors as $author) {
188            $author = trim((string) $author);
189            if ($author === '') {
190                continue;
191            }
192
193            $patterns = [
194                '/^' . preg_quote($author, '/') . '\s*[-:]\s*/i',
195                '/\s*[-:]\s*' . preg_quote($author, '/') . '$/i',
196                '/^' . preg_quote($author, '/') . '\s+/i',
197                '/\s+' . preg_quote($author, '/') . '$/i',
198            ];
199
200            foreach ($patterns as $pattern) {
201                $cleaned = preg_replace($pattern, '', $cleaned);
202            }
203        }
204
205        $cleaned = preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $cleaned);
206        $cleaned = trim($cleaned, ' -_');
207
208        return $cleaned !== '' ? $cleaned : $seriesName;
209    }
210
211    protected function extractBookTitleFromFilename(string $filename, string $seriesName, int $bookNumber): string
212    {
213        $name = preg_replace('/\.[^.]+$/', '', $filename);
214        $patterns = [
215            '/^Book\s*\d+\s*[-_:]\s*/i',
216            '/^Part\s*\d+\s*[-_:]\s*/i',
217            '/^Track\s*\d+\s*[-_:]\s*/i',
218            '/^Disc\s*\d+\s*[-_:]\s*/i',
219            '/^\d+\s*[-_:]\s*/',
220        ];
221
222        foreach ($patterns as $pattern) {
223            $name = preg_replace($pattern, '', $name);
224        }
225
226        if ($seriesName !== '') {
227            $name = preg_replace('/^' . preg_quote($seriesName, '/') . '\s*[-_:]\s*/i', '', $name);
228        }
229
230        if ($bookNumber > 0) {
231            $numberPattern = sprintf('/\b0*%d\b/', $bookNumber);
232            $name = preg_replace($numberPattern, '', $name);
233        }
234
235        $name = preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $name);
236        $name = trim($name, ' -_');
237
238        if ($name === '') {
239            $suffix = $bookNumber > 0 ? " Book {$bookNumber}" : '';
240            return trim($seriesName . $suffix);
241        }
242
243        return $name;
244    }

283    protected function logUiMessage(mixed $message, mixed $data = null): void

287
288            if ($data !== null) {

291            }

299            return;
300        }
301
302        $text = is_string($message) ? $message : (is_array($message) ? json_encode($message, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) : (string) $message);

304        $this->uiService->logMessage($text ?? '');

374    /**
375     * Execute the console command.
376     */
377    public function handle()
378    {
379        if (!$this->uiService) {
380            $this->uiService = app(ImportUIService::class);
381        }
382
383        $uiMode = (string) ($this->option('ui') ?? 'ncurses');
384        if ($uiMode === 'plain') {
385            $this->uiService->setPlainMode(true);
386        }
387
388        [$width, $height] = $this->getTerminalDimensions();
389        $this->uiService->initialize($width, $height);
390
391        try {
392            $this->uiService->drawInitialLayout();
393
394            // Set up signal handlers for graceful interruption
395            $this->setupSignalHandlers();
396
397            // Initialize persistent cache system
398            $this->initializeCache();
399
400            // Create a database backup unless --no-backup is specified
401            if (!$this->option('no-backup')) {
402                $this->uiService->logMessage('Creating a database backup before importing books...');
403
404                // Capture backup command output and redirect to TUI log
405                try {
406                    $this->callSilent('backup:database', ['--suffix' => 'import-books']);
407                    $this->uiService->logMessage('✓ Database backup created successfully.');
408                } catch (\Exception $e) {
409                    $this->uiService->logMessage('⚠️  Database backup failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
410                }
411            }
412
413            $this->uiService->logMessage("🚀 Starting automated audiobook import from download directories...");
414
415            // Check for readline extension and warn if not available (unless in auto mode)
416            if (!$this->option('auto') && !extension_loaded('readline')) {
417                $this->uiService->logMessage(
418                    '❌ PHP readline extension is not enabled. Advanced line editing will not be available.'
419                );
420            }
421
422            // Initialize AI processor
423            $model = $this->option('model');
424            try {
425                $this->aiProcessor = new AIBookProcessor($model, true);
426                $this->uiService->logMessage("✅ AI processor initialized with model: {$model}");
427            } catch (\Exception $e) {
428                $this->uiService->logMessage("❌ Failed to initialize AI processor: " . $e->getMessage());
429                return Command::FAILURE;
430            }
431
432            // Check for specific paths first (files or folders)
433            $specificPaths = $this->argument('path');
434            if (!empty($specificPaths)) {
435                // Ensure it's an array (Laravel may return string for single argument)
436                $specificPaths = is_array($specificPaths) ? $specificPaths : [$specificPaths];
437                $this->uiService->logMessage("📁 Processing specific paths: " . implode(', ', $specificPaths));
438                $audiobooks = $this->processSpecificPaths($specificPaths);
439            } else {
440                // Get directories to scan
441                $directories = $this->getDirectoriesToScan();
442                if (empty($directories)) {
443                    $this->uiService->logMessage("❌ No valid directories found to scan");
444                    return Command::FAILURE;
445                }
446
447                $this->uiService->logMessage("📁 Scanning directories: " . implode(', ', $directories));
448
449                // Scan for audiobooks
450                $audiobooks = $this->scanForAudiobooks($directories);
451            }
452            $this->totalFound = count($audiobooks);
453
454            if (empty($audiobooks)) {
455                $this->uiService->logMessage("ℹ️  No audiobooks found to process.");
456                return Command::SUCCESS;
457            }
458
459            $totalFound = count($audiobooks);
460            $this->uiService->logMessage("📚 Found {$totalFound} potential audiobooks to import");
461
462            // Apply limit
463            $limit = $this->option('limit');
464            if ($limit && $limit > 0 && $totalFound > $limit) {
465                $audiobooks = array_slice($audiobooks, 0, $limit);
466                $this->uiService->logMessage(
467                    "⚠️  Processing limited to {$limit}/{$totalFound} books (--limit=0 for no limit)"
468                );
469            } else {
470                $this->uiService->logMessage("📋 Will process all {$totalFound} books");
471            }
472
473            // Show cost estimate for AI processing
474            $this->showCostEstimate(count($audiobooks));
475
476            // Process each audiobook
477            foreach ($audiobooks as $index => $audiobook) {
478                $this->uiService->updateProgress($index + 1, count($audiobooks));
479                $this->uiService->logMessage('Processing: ' . $audiobook['name']);
480                try {
481                    // Start background processing for upcoming books
482                    $this->startBackgroundProcessing($audiobooks, $index);
483
484                    $this->uiService->logMessage("Debug: Calling processAudiobook for: " . $audiobook['name']);
485                    $this->processAudiobook($audiobook);
486                } catch (\Exception $e) {
487                    $errorMessage = $e->getMessage();
488
489                    // Handle user interruption specially
490                    if (str_contains($errorMessage, '[Request interrupted by user]')) {
491                        $this->skippedBooks[] = [
492                            'path' => $audiobook['path'],
493                            'reason' => 'User interruption - skipped current book',
494                        ];
495                        $skippedPath = basename($audiobook['path']);
496                        $this->uiService->logMessage('⏭️  Skipped due to user interruption: ' . $skippedPath);
497                    } else {
498                        // Regular error handling with detailed stack trace for debugging
499                        $stackTrace = $e->getTraceAsString();
500                        $fullError = $errorMessage . "\n\nStack trace:\n" . $stackTrace;
501
502                        $this->failedBooks[] = [
503                            'path' => $audiobook['path'],
504                            'error' => $errorMessage,
505                        ];
506                        Log::error("Import failed for {$audiobook['path']}: " . $fullError);
507
508                        // Also output to console for debugging
509                        if ($this->output->isVerbose()) {
510                            $this->uiService->logMessage("Full error trace: " . $fullError);
511                        }
512                    }
513                }
514                $this->processBackgroundTasks();
515            }
516
517            // Show summary
518            $this->displaySummary();
519
520            // Save cache before exit and show cache statistics
521        } finally {
522            if ($this->uiService) {
523                $this->uiService->clear();
524            }
525            $this->outputFinalSummary();
526        }
527
528        return Command::SUCCESS;
529    }
530
531    private function outputFinalSummary(): void
532    {
533        // Show summary
534        $this->displaySummary();
535
536        // Save cache before exit and show cache statistics
537        if ($this->cacheEnabled) {
538            $this->saveCacheBeforeExit();
539            $this->displayCacheStatistics();
540        }
541    }

543    private function getTerminalDimensions(): array
544    {
545        if (strtoupper(substr(PHP_OS, 0, 3)) === 'WIN') {
546            return [120, 40]; // Default for Windows
547        }
548
549        try {
550            $size = @shell_exec('stty size 2>/dev/null');
551            if ($size) {
552                $dimensions = explode(' ', trim($size));
553                if (count($dimensions) === 2) {
554                    return [intval($dimensions[1]), intval($dimensions[0])];
555                }
556            }
557        } catch (\Exception $e) {
558            // stty might not be available
559        }
560
561        return [120, 40]; // Default
562    }

664    /**
665     * Process pending background tasks (enhanced with concurrent task management)
666     */
667    protected function processBackgroundTasks(): void
668    {

956    /**

960    {
961        if (extension_loaded('pcntl')) {

963            pcntl_signal(SIGINT, function () {
964                $this->handleUserInterruption();
965            });
966
967            pcntl_signal(SIGTERM, function () {
968                $this->handleUserInterruption();
969            });
970
971            // Enable signal handling
972            pcntl_async_signals(true);
973        }
974    }

976    /**
977     * Handle user interruption (Ctrl+C)
978     */
979    protected function handleUserInterruption(): void
980    {
981        $this->inputInterrupted = true;
982
983        // Set interrupted flag on UI service to break out of input loops
984        if ($this->uiService && method_exists($this->uiService, 'requestInterrupt')) {
985            $this->uiService->requestInterrupt();
986        }
987
988        // Exit after setting flags - this should work with the interrupt checks in loops
989        exit(130);
990    }

1372    /**
1373     * Prompt user to select a cover from available options
1374     * CLI-specific implementation
1375     */
1376    protected function promptForCoverSelection(array $coverOptions): ?string
1377    {
1378        if (empty($coverOptions)) {
1379            return null;
1380        }
1381
1382        $choices = [];
1383        foreach ($coverOptions as $index => $option) {
1384            $choices[(string) ($index + 1)] = $option['label'];
1385        }
1386        $choices['0'] = 'None - skip cover';
1387        $choices['u'] = 'Enter custom URL';
1388
1389        $selection = $this->choice('Select a cover image', $choices, '1');
1390
1391        if ($selection === '0' || $selection === 'None - skip cover') {
1392            return '';
1393        }
1394
1395        if ($selection === 'u' || $selection === 'Enter custom URL') {
1396            $customUrl = $this->ask('Enter cover URL');
1397            return $customUrl ? trim($customUrl) : null;
1398        }
1399
1400        foreach ($coverOptions as $index => $option) {
1401            if ($option['label'] === $selection || (string) ($index + 1) === $selection) {
1402                return $option['url'];
1403            }
1404        }
1405
1406        return null;
1407    }

1586        // Check if it's a file by looking at the path structure (has audio extension)
1587        $audioExtensions = ['mp3', 'm4a', 'm4b', 'flac', 'ogg', 'wma', 'aac'];
1588        $extension = strtolower(pathinfo($audiobook['path'] ?? '', PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
1589        $isFile = in_array($extension, $audioExtensions);
1590        $sourceType = $isFile ? 'file' : 'directory';
1591
1592        $options = [
1593            '1' => 'Skip import (keep both)',
1594            '2' => "Delete source {$sourceType}",
1595            '3' => 'Continue with import anyway',
1596        ];
1597
1598        $action = $this->getImportService()->promptForDuplicateAction(
1599            $options,
1600            fn ($question, $options, $default) => $this->uiService->select($question, $options, $default),
1601            fn ($message) => $this->uiService->logMessage($message),
1602            fn ($audiobook, $force) => $this->cleanupSourceDirectory($audiobook, $force),
1603            $audiobook,
1604            $this->skippedBooks,
1605            $existingBook
1606        );
1607
1608        return $action === 'continue';
1609    }
